BETA Close X CRH plc announced on April 7, 2026, that it purchased 89,094 of its ordinary shares on April 2, 2026, through its broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC, as part of its share buyback program. The total volume-weighted average price paid for these shares was $104.5355, with the highest price paid per share being $106.05 and the lowest at $103.14. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, and following these transactions, CRH plc will have 668,297,613 ordinary shares in issue. Disclaimer* 7 th April 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 2 nd April 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled. Following settlement of the above transactions and subsequent share cancellation CRH will have 668,297,613 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). CRH will also hold 35,634,977 of its ordinary shares in treasury, which represents 5.062% of the issued ordinary share capital of CRH. Ordinary shares held in treasury do not have any voting rights.
